1.name: J.T. Rhoads
1.bio: (heisman) Cerebral pocket passer with exceptional anticipation, precise ball placement, and advanced defensive recognition.

2.name: Jaquon Hall
2.bio: Electrifying dual-threat quarterback with elite scrambling ability, explosive acceleration, and impressive improvisational instincts.

3.name: Aaron Archuelta
3.bio: Prototypical pocket passer with a cannon arm, effortless deep velocity, and outstanding downfield range.

4.name: Nick Gardiner
4.bio: Athletic dual-threat quarterback with long strides, excellent mobility, and dangerous off-script playmaking ability.

5.name: Zac Williams
5.bio: Aggressive gunslinger with tremendous arm strength, impressive deep accuracy, and confident tight-window passing.

6.name: Danny Franklin
6.bio: Intelligent pocket distributor with quick reads, reliable short accuracy, and disciplined decision-making.

9.name: Terrance May

10.bio: Explosive power runner with outstanding contact balance, violent finishing strength, and excellent downhill acceleration.

11.name: Jaylan Matthews Jr.
